selection: Compare v1 best, v1 last and the new candidate on the unchanged validation split using full 640x640 FP32 letterbox. Prefer higher val mAP50-95; export/native checks are mandatory. Do not choose by former test metrics.
recoveredCandidate: v1 last.pt at epoch 20 is added before its one-to-one validation, because the discovered head mismatch invalidated its exclusion by original best.pt selection. This recovers a smaller existing candidate without any further training or former-test use.
hypothesis: Larger capacity and upright packaging with small camera-angle augmentation may improve localization and SKU discrimination. This is a combined candidate, not an ablation that identifies causal contributions.
formerTestRole: Known regression benchmark after v1 inspection; no longer a fresh independent acceptance set for iterative improvements.
